_note: Pre-registered structural experiments. Optimize truthful attention and reflection, never persuasion. A single result becomes contextual evidence, not a universal rule.
ethical_invariants: Never A/B fear, identity threat, false certainty, dependency language or unlabelled science.
Both variants must preserve the same evidence boundary, grounding beat and invitation.
Do not use confusion or withheld essential context as a curiosity tactic.
Audience safety and autonomy signals can veto a retention winner.
protocol: 1. Pre-register one variable, the context where it applies, and a falsifiable hypothesis.
2. Run influence_guard.py on both variants before publishing.
3. Keep concept, body, evidence boundary, grounding and invitation unchanged.
4. Compare platform-specific retention and the relevant attention metric after a pre-declared sample window.
5. Also compare belief-analysis yield, confusion, misinterpretation, distress and dependency proxies.
6. Bank the result as contextual evidence with sample size and confidence; never retire a pattern globally after one test.
7. Repeat in a second concept before promoting a result to a high-weight craft rule.

decision_metrics.minimum: Use a pre-declared platform-specific window; do not call a winner from tiny or highly unequal exposure.

open_hypotheses.hypothesis: A truthful second-person plunge retains better than a direct question for machine-pillar videos without increasing confusion or certainty transfer.
A sub-2-second concrete mechanism reveal retains better than a four-second atmospheric open without reducing comprehension.
A truthful curiosity title outperforms a descriptive title when neither withholds the governing premise or overstates certainty.
